name: Otsego County, NY
findings: Otsego County has 270 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Otsego County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 40 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
